senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בע , v. בָּעָה; cmp. בָּאֵר) [to clear,]

units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:5">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> <he>אש בּוֹעֶרֶת</he> burning fire.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>כשם שהסנה בּוֹעֵר וכ׳</he> as the bush is burning &c. [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, end <he>לבוערים בע״ז</he>, read <he>לבוסרים</he>, v. <cite ref="B01010"><he>בָּסַר</he> I</cite>, Var. <he>לכיפרים</he>.]

senses.gloss: to clear, remove (out of existence or out of possession).
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 6a:15">Pes. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>זקוק לבָעֵר</he> is bound to remove (the leaven by burning or otherwise); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:7">Shebi. VII, 7</cite> <he>חייב לב׳</he> is bound to remove (dispose of the fruits of the Sabbath year in due time). [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (p. 230ᵇ ed. Amst.) <he>מבערים את העון</he>, read with <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 708:5">Yalk. Num. 708</cite>, <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 11:1">Sifré Num. 11</cite> <he>מערערין</he>; oth. vers. <he>מבררין</he>, v. <cite ref="B01335"><he>בָּרַר</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:20">B. Kam. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>וּבִעֵר זו השן</he> ‘and it clears’ (<cite ref="Exodus 22:4">Ex. XXII, 4</cite>) this refers to injury by the tooth (animal’s eating). [

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to start a fire, enkindle. V. בְּעֵרָה.]
to start or entertain a fire, to clear a field.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 20a:5">Sabb. 20ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>לא תבערו וכ׳</he> <cite ref="Exodus 35:3">Ex. XXXV, 3</cite>) <he>בכל … אי אתה מַבְעִיר</he> ‘in all your dwellings’ thou art not permitted to start a fire; v. <cite ref="E00048"><he>הַבְעָרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60b:13">B. Kam. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>הַבְּעֵרָה שהִבְעַרְתִּי</he> the fire which I set (to Zion).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 55b:12">Ib. 55ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Ex. l. c. 5) <he>עד דעביד כעין מבעיר</he> only when he acts like the one setting fire (to clear the field, i.e. criminal negligence); a. e.
